description: ExtendFootprintTTL (CAP-0046-12) whose operation source is a muxed M... account with ID 2^53+1 (CAP-0027). stellar-core accepts a muxed source on this Soroban operation; it rejects one only on InvokeHostFunction (TransactionFrame::validateSorobanMemo, protocol 25+). js-stellar-sdk 17.4.0's TransactionBuilder refuses to build it (js-stellar-sdk#1906). Core extends the Stellar Asset Contract instance's TTL.

core_version_and_commit.basis: the testnet network's core release as recorded for the other protocol-30 captures (RPC getVersionInfo); the data-lake emitter does not publish its core build, so this identifies the network's core release rather than the exact process that wrote the primary artifact

xdr_json.why: the muxed operation source as submitted; Horizon reports the same source_account_muxed
core extended the instance to the closing ledger plus extend_to

expected_state_changes_or_participants.indexer_must: accept a muxed source on a Soroban operation other than InvokeHostFunction; store participants as the base G... account (or the full M... form), never a 32-byte truncation of the muxed key

validation_evidence.check: rs-stellar-xdr strict decode and byte-exact re-encode
ledger header hash recomputed from header bytes and matched to the recorded ledger hash
validation_evidence.method: ledgerwitness verify; ledger hash independently read from Horizon testnet /ledgers/{seq}

validation_evidence.check: scp_value.tx_set_hash and tx_set_result_hash recomputed from the artifact
every envelope hashes under the declared passphrase to a processed result

validation_evidence.method: not applicable to network captures: core goldens are produced by core's own test suite under its test passphrase; see docs/spec/normalization.md

validation_evidence.check: same ledger fetched from RPC getLedgers is equal under stellar-core's --check-lcm normalization once the LCM extension is ignored
transaction successful, muxed operation source and its ID as Horizon reports them; ledger transaction count
validation_evidence.method: GET horizon-testnet /transactions/{hash}, /transactions/{hash}/operations (source_account_muxed, source_account_muxed_id) and /ledgers/5818357 (successful plus failed transaction counts)

validation_evidence.check: the network accepts a transaction js-stellar-sdk 17.4.0's TransactionBuilder refuses to build
validation_evidence.method: generators/testnet-capture/capture-testnet.mjs shape 5 sets the muxed source after the builder runs; the transaction succeeded on testnet

license_or_provenance_notes: Public testnet ledger data. Keys used to submit the focus transaction were generated per run, funded by friendbot and discarded; no secret material is stored.
